name: NASA Information Security Policy
notes: Top-level NASA policy for information security. Establishes roles, responsibilities, and requirements for protecting NASA information and information systems.

derives_from.note: NASA security authority derives from the National Aeronautics and Space Act.
FISMA requires each federal agency to establish an information security program.
Implements OMB information management and security requirements for NASA.

references.note: Adopts NIST 800-53 controls as the baseline for NASA information systems.
